## Post-vaccination symptoms by age group

This line chart shows the observed symptom-free rate for each age band. The source age field only contains grouped age categories, so the chart keeps those categories on the x-axis instead of inventing exact ages.

```{python}
#| label: fig-age-efficiency
#| fig-cap: "Observed symptom-free rate by age"
#| echo: false

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

vax = pd.read_csv("covid_vaccination.csv", low_memory=False)
daily = pd.read_csv("covid_daily_survey.csv", low_memory=False)

daily = daily[["VSAFE_SYSTEM_ID", "HAD_SYMPTOMS"]].dropna().copy()
daily["HAD_SYMPTOMS"] = daily["HAD_SYMPTOMS"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
daily = daily[daily["HAD_SYMPTOMS"].isin(["yes", "no"])].copy()

outcome = daily.groupby("VSAFE_SYSTEM_ID").agg(
  symptom_free=("HAD_SYMPTOMS", lambda values: int((values != "yes").all()))
).reset_index()

merged = outcome.merge(
  vax[["VSAFE_SYSTEM_ID", "age_at_vax_yrs", "DOSE_NUMBER"]],
  on="VSAFE_SYSTEM_ID",
  how="inner",
)

age_order = ["0.5-04", "05-11", "12-19", "20-29", "30-39", "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "70-79", "80+"]

merged = merged.dropna(subset=["age_at_vax_yrs", "DOSE_NUMBER"])
merged = merged[merged["age_at_vax_yrs"] != "Invalid"].copy()
merged = merged[merged["DOSE_NUMBER"].isin(["First", "Second", "Third"])].copy()
merged["age_at_vax_yrs"] = pd.Categorical(merged["age_at_vax_yrs"], categories=age_order, ordered=True)
age_summary = merged.groupby("age_at_vax_yrs", observed=False)["symptom_free"].mean().reindex(age_order)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 6))
ax = age_summary.mul(100).plot(kind="line", marker="o", linewidth=2.5, figsize=(11, 6), color="#2f6f9f")

ax.set_xlabel("Age (years)")
ax.set_ylabel("Symptom-free rate (%)")
ax.set_title("Vaccine efficacy-related symptoms by age band")
plt.xticks(rotation=20, ha="right")
plt.ylim(0, 100)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

This is still an exploratory visualization based on reported symptoms rather than a causal estimate of vaccine timing. Because the source data only reports age bands, the chart uses age categories rather than exact ages.
